title: Feedback regulation through degradation
note: In gene-expression and metabolic data, oscillation or saturation almost always reflects feedback regulation: production balanced by degradation, or upstream regulator balanced by downstream sink. The fitted dynamic captures the steady-state behavior; the perturbation experiment captures the loop's response time.

title: Statistical signal, not diagnosis
note: Biological-data outputs from Aurora are screening signals, not diagnoses. The relevant downstream step is always the experimentalist's interpretation — which condition, which timepoint, which control. Aurora's role is to surface the candidate; the human decides what it means.
